summary: When an article image reads successfully but is not a supported raster type, UploadArticleImage returns an actionable error (resolved path, byte size, detected type, and Git LFS pointer detection) rather than a bare MIME string.
reason: A successful read that yields text/plain almost always means the path points at the wrong file — most often an unresolved Git LFS pointer or an SVG/text file with an image extension. The original 'unsupported image type "text/plain; charset=utf-8"' error gave no path or cause and led to repeated publish retries.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests assert the absolute path, byte count, and detected MIME type for both an unresolved Git LFS pointer and a non-image text file; neither reaches an upload request.
